title: Understanding OLS Solutions
text: To determine if adding more features yields a unique OLS solution, consider the relationship between the number of observations and the number of parameters.

title: Number of Parameters vs. Observations
text: In a linear regression model, the number of parameters (including the intercept) should not exceed the number of observations to ensure a unique solution.

title: Unique Solution Condition
text: A unique OLS solution exists when the design matrix has full column rank, which occurs when the number of observations is greater than the number of parameters.

title: Checking the Condition
text: Given $$n=30$$ observations and $$30$$ parameters, does the design matrix have full column rank?
